Title: Start loan application from landing page
Preconditions: User is logged in, navigated to /loans
Steps: 1. Click "Start Your Loan Application" button | 2. Wait for application to be created | 3. Verify redirect to customer details form
Expected Result: User is redirected to /loans/application/{id}/customer-details with a new application ID created

Title: Submit customer details form with valid data
Preconditions: User is on customer details form page, application ID exists in URL
Steps: 1. Fill in Full Name with "John Doe" | 2. Fill in Email with "john.doe@example.com" | 3. Fill in Phone with "555-123-4567" | 4. Fill in Address with "123 Main St" | 5. Fill in Date of Birth with a valid past date | 6. Fill in SSN with "123-45-6789" | 7. Click "Continue to Income Details" button | 8. Verify redirect
Test Data: Full Name: John Doe | Email: john.doe@example.com | Phone: 555-123-4567 | Address: 123 Main St | DOB: 1990-01-01 | SSN: 123-45-6789
Expected Result: Form submits successfully, customer details saved to database with status "customer_details_submitted", user redirected to /loans/application/{id}/income-details

Title: Submit income details form and complete application
Preconditions: User is on income details form page, customer details already submitted
Steps: 1. Select Employment Status "Full-time Employed" | 2. Fill in Employer Name "Acme Corp" | 3. Fill in Annual Income "75000" | 4. Select Employment Duration "3-5 years" | 5. Fill in Additional Income "5000" | 6. Click "Submit Application" button | 7. Wait for success message | 8. Verify redirect
Test Data: Employment Status: full-time | Employer: Acme Corp | Annual Income: 75000 | Duration: 3-5 years | Additional: 5000
Expected Result: Form submits successfully, income details saved with status "income_details_submitted", success message displayed, user redirected to /loans after 2 seconds

Title: Complete full loan application flow from landing to submission
Preconditions: User is logged in with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Navigate to /loans landing page | 2. Click "Start Your Loan Application" | 3. Fill customer details form completely | 4. Submit customer details | 5. Fill income details form completely | 6. Submit income details | 7. Verify completion
Test Data: Valid user data for all form fields across both forms
Expected Result: Application progresses through all stages: initiated → customer_details_submitted → income_details_submitted. All data persisted correctly in database. User sees confirmation and is redirected to loans page.

Title: Navigate loan application from header menu
Preconditions: User is logged in, viewing any protected page
Steps: 1. Click "Loans" link in header navigation | 2. Verify landing page loads | 3. Verify Oktawave branding elements present | 4. Check page accessibility
Expected Result: Loans landing page loads successfully, Oktawave blue colors (#0047AB) visible, page follows WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines, all interactive elements keyboard accessible

Title: Access income details form without submitting customer details first
Preconditions: Application exists but status is still "initiated"
Steps: 1. Navigate directly to /loans/application/{id}/income-details | 2. Fill and submit income form
Test Data: Application ID: valid but status is "initiated"
Expected Result: Backend returns 400 error with message "Customer details must be submitted first". Frontend displays error message. Form does not submit.

Title: Submit customer details with missing required fields
Preconditions: User on customer details form page
Steps: 1. Leave Full Name empty | 2. Fill other required fields | 3. Click submit button | 4. Verify HTML5 validation triggers
Test Data: Full Name: empty | Other fields: valid data
Expected Result: Browser HTML5 validation prevents form submission with message for required field. No API call made. Form remains on same page.

Title: Submit income details with negative or zero annual income
Preconditions: User on income details form, customer details submitted
Steps: 1. Fill Employment Status and Employer | 2. Enter Annual Income "-1000" or "0" | 3. Attempt to submit
Expected Result: HTML5 min="0" validation prevents negative values. Zero is technically allowed by frontend but may fail business logic validation if backend implements minimum income rules.

Title: Access non-existent loan application ID
Steps: 1. Navigate to /loans/application/invalid-id-12345/customer-details | 2. Attempt to submit form
Expected Result: Backend returns 404 error with message "Loan application not found". Frontend displays error message. User unable to proceed.

Title: Landing page displays all Oktawave branding elements
Steps: 1. Check hero section background color | 2. Verify Oktawave name in header | 3. Check button styling | 4. Verify color scheme matches brand guidelines
Expected Result: Hero section uses Oktawave blue gradient (#0047AB to #0066CC), logo in header, consistent typography, buttons use brand colors, overall design matches Oktawave style guide

Title: Customer details form validates email format
Steps: 1. Fill all fields with valid data | 2. Enter Email "invalid-email-format" | 3. Attempt to submit
Expected Result: HTML5 email input validation triggers, prevents submission with "Please include '@' in the email address" message

Title: Income details form accepts zero additional income
Steps: 1. Fill all required fields with valid data | 2. Leave Additional Income as "0" | 3. Submit form
Expected Result: Form submits successfully, additional income stored as 0 in database, no errors shown

Title: All form inputs have proper labels and accessibility attributes
Preconditions: User on any loan application form page
Steps: 1. Navigate to customer details form | 2. Inspect label associations | 3. Navigate to income details form | 4. Check ARIA attributes | 5. Test with screen reader
Expected Result: All form inputs have associated labels with htmlFor, required fields marked with aria-required or required attribute, error messages have role="alert", forms navigable via keyboard

Title: Submit customer details with invalid date format for DOB
Steps: 1. Attempt to manually enter DOB as "13/32/2025" | 2. Try to submit
Expected Result: HTML5 date input prevents invalid date entry, browser shows date picker, invalid manual entry rejected before submission

Title: Submit income details without selecting employment status
Steps: 1. Fill all fields except Employment Status | 2. Attempt to submit
Expected Result: HTML5 required validation prevents submission, browser shows "Please select an item in the list" message for dropdown

Title: Access loan routes while not authenticated
Preconditions: User is not logged in (no auth token)
Expected Result: ProtectedRoute component redirects to /login page, loan pages not accessible without authentication, auth token required for all loan API calls

Title: Submit customer details with SSN exceeding 11 characters
Steps: 1. Fill all fields with valid data | 2. Attempt to enter SSN "123-45-6789-99999" (exceeds maxLength) | 3. Submit
Expected Result: Input maxLength="11" attribute prevents entry beyond 11 characters, user cannot type more than allowed, form validation ensures SSN length constraint

Title: Trigger income details form without proper application state
Preconditions: Application status is "initiated", user navigates directly to income form URL
Steps: 1. Create application (status: initiated) | 2. Skip customer details form | 3. Navigate to /loans/application/{id}/income-details via URL manipulation | 4. Submit income form
Expected Result: Backend validates application status, returns 400 error, frontend shows "Customer details must be submitted first", user must complete customer details before proceeding
